source_book: Modern GPU Programming For MLSys (MLC Community) + NVIDIA Blackwell Tuning/Compatibility Guides

test_cases.prompt: My fp16 GEMM on B200 only reaches about 30% of what I expected — first help me decide whether it's bandwidth or the Tensor Cores not being fed.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and estimate FLOPs/bytes, lay out the evidence matrix, and give the minimal experiments.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Should this fused RMSNorm kernel move to TMA? Do a roofline diagnosis first.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger, identify the low arithmetic intensity, and evaluate regular block transfers and fusion gains.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: I have Nsight metrics and shapes — rank the optimization priorities for a B200 kernel for me.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and rank based on measurements, not a checklist of tricks.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How much memory does a B200 have in total?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; this is a spec query.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Write me an ordinary Python bubble sort.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; unrelated to GPU kernels.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: I only know the end-to-end model throughput got slower; I don't know which kernel it is.
test_cases.expected_behavior: May be partially invoked to build an observation plan, but should first require a broken-down profile; must not attribute the slowdown directly to a single kernel.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These tests are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
